fusions.name: Full Weight Settles
fusions.desc: After 1.5 seconds your weight comes down, which deals 34 damage to every enemy within 4 tiles, ignoring armour.

fusions.name: Rolling Swell
fusions.desc: Pushes a slow swell of water into the first enemy it meets, which deals 8 damage. Holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Unbothered
fusions.desc: Reduces the damage you take by 25% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Blubber Buffer
fusions.desc: When a non-fire blow hurts you, you gain a ward worth 15% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 18 seconds.
